# OPBX

> OPBX is an open-source (MIT) business PBX built on the Cloudonix CPaaS. It connects AI voice agents and human teams on one phone system: extensions, ring groups, call queues, IVR menus, business hours, AI assistants, an auto dialer and a browser web phone. Cloudonix handles SIP, media and telephony; OPBX decides call routing in real time.

OPBX can be self-hosted for free on your own infrastructure (Docker), or used as a managed cloud service.

## Get started

- [Create an account](/ui/register): sign up for the managed OPBX cloud service
- [Sign in](/ui/login): the OPBX administration interface
- [Install guide](/install): self-host OPBX with the guided installer
- [Service status](/status): current status of the OPBX cloud service

## Documentation

- [OPBX documentation](https://developers.cloudonix.com/opbx): user guide, administration and architecture
- [OPBX REST API](https://developers.cloudonix.com/opbxRestOpenAPI): OpenAPI reference for automating OPBX
- [Cloudonix documentation](https://developers.cloudonix.com/): the CPaaS platform OPBX runs on
